aggregation: Mean/SD of total counts within each seed dataset; do not pool 600 module updates as 600 independent datasets.

statuses.RECORDED: Retained historical raw counter, with original counter semantics.
statuses.DERIVED: Exact code/config/counter formula, explicitly not direct measurement.
statuses.CONFIRMED_ZERO: No such operator in the supplied implementation.
statuses.UNAVAILABLE: Counter not retained and cannot be recovered exactly from historical logs.

definitions.likelihood_evaluations: One observation-likelihood/log-likelihood evaluated for one particle state; vectorized arrays count their particle entries, not Python calls.
definitions.candidate_evaluations: One newly proposed state or generated binary subset submitted to candidate scoring. Existing cloud states and copied resampled states are excluded. EC-QPF subset scores also appear as fitness_evaluations; columns are not additive.
definitions.proposal_attempts: The historical proposal counter. QM/native and fair-budget count each candidate-generation attempt; QGPF counts each offspring search episode (four candidate generations); EC-QPF has no such historical proposal counter and is unavailable.
definitions.rotation_bit_routine_calls: One classical bit-level rotation routine call, including zero-angle/no-change branches in QM. Fair-budget uses bit_length times recorded rotation_proposals; it is not a physical quantum-gate count. QGPF conditionally calls _rotate_probability, whose 30-seed count was not recorded.
definitions.crossover_proposals: One invocation of the scalar arithmetic crossover proposal; copied offspring/elites do not count. QGPF implementation contains no crossover.
definitions.bit_measurements: One classical Bernoulli bit observation. QM has one draw per rotation-bit routine; QGPF has two bit draws per dimension/bit/candidate generation; EC-QPF has one draw per swarm/subset-bit/generation. No quantum-device measurement is performed.
definitions.persistent_probability_entry_updates: One stored probability entry written by a probability-update operator, excluding initialization. QGPF updates only mismatched bits; EC-QPF updates all swarm entries after each non-stopping generation. QM computes measurement probabilities locally and has no persistent probability state.
definitions.fitness_evaluations: Historical EC-QPF search/objective counter only: one subset score for the swarm or one existing singleton considered for the exact/systematic comparator. The exact comparator uses an argmin-distance scan, not one exponential evaluation per entry. Final returned-subset diagnostic and optimal-fitness summaries are excluded, as in the original counter. These are not observation likelihoods.
definitions.candidate_distance_evaluations: Historical EC-QPF candidate-cloud distance count (one candidate state to observed center). Diagnostic distance recomputations are excluded, as in the original counter.
definitions.generation_iterations: QM/native and fair-budget: one generation for one low-particle candidate; QGPF: one generation of one offspring search; EC-QPF: one full swarm generation. These different work units must not be compared as equal costs.

validation.formula: L = N*T + 2*C + C/G for non-bootstrap unlimited runs

limitations: Counters describe these independent implementations/modules, not the computational cost of the original published algorithms.
No original algorithm, GPU, quantum circuit, oracle, or physical quantum gate is executed.
Scalar/vector state likelihoods, binary-mask fitness scores, bit observations, and generations are distinct work units.
Columns can overlap: generated EC masks are also fitness evaluations; bit rotations and persistent QGPF probability updates can be the same operation.
Final diagnostic fitness/distance recomputations and initialization are excluded from historical EC counters; counter totals do not measure all work.
Classical contextual T*N derivations lack an archived source-code hash binding in the original run CSV.
Missing native/QGPF branch-level means remain unavailable; a seed-0 replay is an additional check, not their replacement.
